title: PMO floating target isolation
decision: When a Demand opens PMO with an explicit Tab target, the floating surface keeps that target through Agent attachment and never focuses an older PMO Session while the target is pending.
constraints: The existing PMO Topic and Workbench remain the single surface implementation.
An explicit target is authoritative for the whole open transition; absence of the target Agent is a waiting state, not permission to choose another Session.
Direct PMO opening without an explicit Demand target retains the existing first available PMO behavior.
The fix must preserve the Demand-to-Tab mapping and not add a second Session registry.
acceptance: Opening a newly created Demand cannot display an older PMO Session before the target Agent attaches.
After the target Agent attaches, the floating panel focuses the target Tab and its conversation.
A direct PMO open without a target still selects an available PMO Session.
Focused tests, typecheck, mutation evidence, and a production caller check cover the target isolation path.
